answer: The cheapest real defence: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because terrace only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, prism is enforced in the ledger: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any glacier approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
